summary: Explains adding constructed features (compose, keyed_groups, groups) to an inventory plugin with Constructable and the constructed doc fragment, calling the corresponding methods per host, ordering compose first, and using strict to error on undefined variables.
questions: How do I let users create groups from variables in my inventory plugin?
What are compose, keyed_groups and groups in constructed inventory?
Why are undefined variables ignored in my keyed_groups?
In which order should I call the constructed helper methods?

answer_card.title: Constructed features in inventory plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `Constructable` and `extends_documentation_fragment: [constructed]`.
- `compose` → `_set_composite_vars` (vars from Jinja2)
- `keyed_groups` → `_add_host_to_keyed_groups` (groups from var values)
- `groups` → `_add_host_to_composed_groups` (groups from conditionals)

Call each per host with (option, vars dict, hostname). Call `_set_composite_vars` first so groups can use composed vars. Undefined vars are ignored by default; pass `strict=` to make them errors.
